items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Turrentine and little blind Chris Anderson and Joe Lee Wilson. That's the group that Archie Shepp took up.

ctx.x: Anyway, they had sandwiched us in between -- they was waiting on Clark Terry's big band to show up and Elvin and Jimmy Garrison and Joe Farrell was playing before we was scheduled to come on and, oh, they did it. Elvin sounded so beautiful. Standing ovation and we had to follow them. I didn't even take a bass up there because I figured I could borrow somebody's bass. I was asking Joe Benjamin (PHONETIC) -- Joe Benjamin was going to play next with Clark Terry, so I asked him can I use his bass. He said, 'No, you…

From that moment on, every job that Archie Shepp would get, he'd call me. 'Mr. Ware --' record dates, jobs, we played up in Buffalo. They had some whole week of music, quite a few groups -- Cannonball, Mongo, Tito Puente (PHONETIC). Philly Billy Joe Jones worked with us, Archie Shep (PHONETIC), Tommy Turrentine and little blind Chris Anderson and Joe Lee Wilson. That's the group that Archie Shepp took up.
